CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(FreightTM__Length__c), ISBLANK(FreightTM__Width__c), ISBLANK(FreightTM__Number_of_Pallets__c), FreightTM__Length__c <= 0, FreightTM__Width__c <= 0, FreightTM__Number_of_Pallets__c <= 0, FreightTM__Width__c > 96 ), NULL, CEILING( FreightTM__Number_of_Pallets__c / FLOOR(96 / FreightTM__Width__c) ) * FreightTM__Length__c / 12 )
CustomField.label: Total Linear Feet
